scope.market_definition: The Medical Waste Container Market encompasses the production and distribution of containers specifically designed for the safe disposal of medical waste. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers operating globally to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of medical waste containers from manufacturers to end-users.
Service providers offer waste management solutions including the supply of medical waste containers.
System integrators provide comprehensive solutions that include medical waste container systems.

## Azienda certificata ed eco-friendly

[separatore rosso corto]

I prodotti APmedical sono sottoposti a rigide certificazioni di qualità, garantendo il rispetto
delle normative internazionali più rigorose in termini di sicurezza. Realizzati con materiali
plastici di alta qualità, come il polipropilene copolimero colorato con pigmenti privi di cadmio o
altri materiali pesanti, i contenitori APmedical offrono resistenza ai fluidi e ai solventi.
Inoltre, consentono lo smaltimento attraverso l’incenerimento senza l’emissione di gas nocivi,
rispettando le normative internazionali sull’ambiente.

La linea Sharps Containers di APmedical, dedicata alla raccolta di aghi e rifiuti taglienti, è
progettata per resistere alla perforazione da parte degli aghi e delle cannule, che rappresenta la
principale fonte di infortuni per il personale ospedaliero. La linea Waste Containers, invece, offre
contenitori per rifiuti ospedalieri pericolosi. Questi contenitori sono dotati di un collante
perimetrale speciale che garantisce una sigillatura ermetica, prevenendo qualsiasi rischio di
infezione.

Gli contenitori APmedical sono estremamente robusti e solidi, in grado di resistere agli urti e alle
condizioni di trasporto più avverse verso discariche o impianti di incenerimento. Sono anche testati
per sopportare diverse temperature di utilizzo, garantendo la loro affidabilità in ogni situazione.

Who We Are

## ABOUT US

Choice MedWaste was founded in 2015 by Bruce and Matt Georgov. Bruce and Matt combined have over
forty years of waste hauling experience. In 2023, Ryan Georgov, joined the team and created their
[hazardous waste][32] division. Choice MedWaste is now able to handle all our facilities' regulated
waste streams.

 

Our goal is to become your number one resource for regulated [waste disposal][33] in Delaware,
Maryland, Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Whether you need help identifying specific waste streams,
on-site logistics, custom containers or scheduled pick ups, the team at Choice MedWaste is here to
deliver solutions to make your life easier.

## Compliance vs. Cost.
## No Need to Compromise.

Balancing strict medical waste compliance with tight budgets can feel overwhelming. Neither can be
sacrificed – compromising compliance to save money could lead to serious legal, financial, and
ethical consequences, while ignoring costs isn’t sustainable.

Healthcare facilities must find a way to achieve 100% compliance and stay within budget.
Fortunately, we have a solution. 

## Protection Without Compromise Is Possible

### 100% Compliance

Avoid fines & penalties with trained staff and a ‘cradle to grave’ service provider that doesn’t cut
corners.

### Reliable Service Delivery

Maintain a safe environment and minimise disruptions when waste is collected on schedule.

[business man hand holding lightbulb with using calculator to cal]

### No Hidden Costs

With transparent pricing you’ll avoid unexpected nasty charges that exceed your budget.

[ Get a quote ][105]

## Medical waste compliance is complex but it shouldn't compromise patient care

As a healthcare professional, your focus should be on patient care — not the complexities of waste
management. You deserve a partner who understands the balance between cost and compliance,
protecting people, the environment, and your budget.

## Protecting healthcare facilities since 1998.

**Our commitment to compliance is at our core.**

Over **30,000+** facilities trust our expert advice and ability to manage costs whilst keeping you
compliant.

[55-gallon-drum-client][55-gallon-drum-client]

Container Distributors, Inc. supplies a full range of industrial containers engineered for regulated
waste, chemical handling, and material transport. Our inventory includes steel drums, plastic drums,
steel barrels, fiber drums, drum liners, and specialty containers used across environmental,
industrial, and hazardous‑material operations.

As a national supplier based in St. Louis, we support customers who need reliable solutions for
**hazardous waste containers**, chemical packaging, and compliant disposal workflows. Our team
provides knowledgeable guidance on selecting the right container type, including UN‑rated
**55‑gallon steel drums** to lightweight **plastic drums** and rugged **fiber drums** used for lab
packs, absorbents, and dry materials.

We maintain a wide range of [in‑stock items][48] that meet current DOT, EPA, and UN performance
standards for the shipment and storage of regulated materials. With fast delivery, responsive
customer service, and a deep understanding of compliance requirements, Container Distributors, Inc.
is your single source for:
* [Steel drums][49] & steel barrels
* Plastic drums & tight‑head/open‑head options

## Hazardous Waste Container for Hazardous Material Handling

[poly-drum-white-bg][poly-drum-white-bg]

When hazardous waste must be contained, transported, or consolidated, the packaging you choose
directly affects compliance, safety, and operational efficiency. A properly rated **hazardous waste
container** ensures your materials remain secure throughout handling and disposal.

Container Distributors’ hazardous waste container lineup includes durable **fiber drums**, rigid
**steel drums**, chemical‑resistant **plastic drums**, and compatible **drum liners** designed for
lab packs, chemical waste, pharmaceutical disposal, and regulated solids or liquids. Each container
type is tested to meet UN performance standards for drop resistance, leak prevention, and structural
integrity.

Our UN‑approved boxes and drums support a wide range of volumes, from small 3‑gallon fiber drums to
full‑size 66‑gallon hazardous waste containers. Whether you need a lightweight option for dry
materials or a heavy‑duty steel barrel for aggressive chemicals, we provide solutions that balance
strength, certification, and cost efficiency.

Explore our complete selection of hazardous waste containers engineered for safe, compliant
hazardous‑material handling across environmental, industrial, and waste‑management operations.

[LEARN MORE][51]

## What You Need to Know About Hazardous Waste Containment

[A Buckets/Pails Polyethylene Container in white with a metal handle and a separate lid beside
it.][A Buckets/Pails Polyethylene Container in white with a metal handle and a separate lid beside
it.]

Safe hazardous waste containment depends on choosing containers that match the chemical and physical
properties of your waste stream. From steel drums and HDPE containers to fiberboard boxes and IBC
totes, each option plays a specific role in preventing leaks, spills, and exposure. Understanding UN
ratings, DOT placards, and regulatory expectations helps ensure that every container in your
facility supports safe handling and compliant storage.

If your operation manages corrosive liquids, reactive materials, contaminated solids, or mixed waste
streams, the right containment strategy can significantly reduce risk.

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.

* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.[

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][31]
* [Embeds][32]
* [Slide mode][33]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.[
See community stories][34]
[Markdown your team writes illustration]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown

## Since 1993, Leonel Waste Management Corporation (Leonel) has been providing effective,
## thorough, and continuous waste collection services to our clients.

**Scroll down to learn more**


# Services Offered

## Collection, Hauling, and
## Disposal of MSW

We currently serve several cities in Metro Manila. We cover everything from garbage collection to
solid waste segregation to proper transportation and disposal to sanitary landfills.

## Street Sweeping
## with Trucks

We offer fast and efficient curbside clean-ups by deploying street sweeper trucks.

## Events Waste Management
## (with Awareness Advertisments)

We can station garbage compactor trucks in events for quicker cleanups. If you would like to, you
can place your ads on our trucks to relay your company's environmental concern to the public.

# Fleet of Equipment

## Garbage Compactor Trucks

Garbage Compactor Trucks are the main vehicles used for garbage collection all around the world,
mainly because of its efficiency. A ten wheeler garbage compactor truck can accommodate as much as
1.5 times the capacity of a ten wheeler dump truck. Depending on the client's requirements, we have
various sized compactor trucks available to choose from.

## Ten Wheeler Dump Trucks

Dump trucks are more ideal to use for collection of very bulky solid waste. Call our office to ask
for the availability of long dump trucks, which are longer than the standard ten wheeler dump trucks
you see on the streets.

## Industrial Roll-off Garbage Dumpsters

Roll-off garbage dumpsters are left in an area where they act as receptacles for garbage for a
certain period of time. It serves as the entire vicinity's giant garbage bin. It is then collected
during its scheduled pick-up time, emptied, and then returned to the client. A single industrial
roll-off garbage dumpster can accommodate two to three mid to high rise residential condominiums
daily.

## Street Sweeper Trucks

Street Sweeper Trucks are ideal for curb side cleaning. A single street sweeper truck can do the job
of several people in sweeping the curbs in a fraction of the time, generating you savings in the
process.

## Water Tanker with High Pressure Washer"

This water tanker with a high pressure washer can provide solutions for cleansing of concrete floors
that that need to be rid of stubborn dirt and odors which can no longer be dealt with using a broom
and a dustpan.

# Photo Gallery

# Mission-Vision

**Our mission** is to satisfy our stakeholders by providing our customers value, our fellow citizens
peace of mind, our employees fair compensation, and our investors an equitable return. **Our
vision** is to be the foremost integrated waste solutions company in the country by setting the
benchmark in quality and reliability in garbage collection and disposal.

# About Us

**Leonel Waste Management Corporation (Leonel) was registered in 1993 with the objective of
providing effective, thorough, and continuous waste collection services to our clients.**

Our fleet of equipment composed of garbage compactors, dump trucks, roll-on roll-of trucks, sweeper
trucks, water trucks, and heavy equipment, as well as our workforce, is more than enough to
adequately meet any new assignment. Leonel has been aggressively looking for opportunities to join
the renewable energy industry - in line with our commitment to contribute to the environment.

Leonel's long-term objective is not only to contribute to cleanliness and beautification, but also
to advance efforts in addressing the issues of solid waste by turning this into an opportunity
through innovation and collaborations with the renewable energy sector.

## Reusable Sharps and Pharm Management

Safe, Compliant, and Reliable Disposal of Medical Waste for Healthcare and Beyond.

MediWaste Offers a sustainable compliance solution for large quantity generators looking for
Reduction in environmental impact while maintaining the highest quality standards for safety and
regulatory compliance We provide the Rehrig family of reusable sharps and pharm containers and
custom build a service that can include self service or a full service Options For your healthcare
facilities.

[ Learn More ][131]

## Hazardous Waste

Expert Handling and Disposal of Hazardous Waste with Safety and Compliance at the Core

Handling hazardous waste requires expertise and precision, and MediWaste is equipped to manage even
the most challenging waste streams. Our hazardous waste services include chemical disposal, lab
packing, site mitigation, and soil remediation, all conducted by our HAZWOPER-certified technicians.
We ensure that all hazardous materials are disposed of safely and in full compliance with regulatory
standards, protecting both your business and the environment.

[ Learn More ][132]

## Document Destruction

Secure, Confidential, and Compliant Document Destruction You Can Trust.

Protecting sensitive information is critical, and MediWaste offers secure document shredding
services to help you stay compliant with HIPAA and other confidentiality standards. Whether you need
on-site or off site shredding, our NAID-certified services ensure that your documents are securely
disposed of, safeguarding your data and maintaining your reputation. From transportation to
destruction, we handle the entire process with the highest level of security and professionalism.

## Why Professional Waste Disposal?

Professional medical waste management is the most effective way to ensure that your comunity remains
safe, you are complying with regulations, and your organization remains trusted. When medical waste
is simply thrown in the trash, individuals who come into contact with it can be harmed.
Additionally, improperly handled materials can end up in public spaces, pollute waterways, and leach
into the soil. Regulations on the local, state, and federal levels set important standards that
businesses, clinics, hospitals, and homes must follow. When an organization breaks these rules
designed to keep people safe, trust is broken. Medical Waste Pros can find you unique solutions for
your exact needs. 

## Looking for something local?

Medical Waste Pros proudly offers a network of convenient drop-off locations for sharps and
pharmaceuticals nationwide. Easily locate a nearby facility to safely dispose of your small
quantities of sharps and medications.

sizes. Our partners offer varying disposal frequencies and options to fit the exact needs of
customers. Whether you need small quanitity sharps mailback, frequent hazardous waste pickup,
one-time pharmaceuticals disposal, or another service, our team has customized quotes for your
project. Unsure of what service is right for you? Medical Waste Pros can help you determine the

## A unified center for all your waste management needs.

#### Commercial Waste Management:

End-to-end waste management for businesses—collection, segregation, and recycling. Responsible
handling of recyclable and organic waste. Helps your business meet sustainability and compliance
goals.

#### Residential Waste Management

MSGP partners with communities to promote waste segregation at source. From doorstep collection to
composting and recycling, we help create cleaner neighborhoods and greener cities.

#### Smart Waste Management:

We combine technology with sustainable practices to turn waste into resources. At our Material
Recovery Facility, advanced systems process organic waste into compost and recyclables into reusable
materials.

* ## There’s a Toter® to Meet Everyone’s Needs
  
  Your needs are simple — collecting and transporting waste from its source to the next point in the
  waste stream. Toter is the waste container manufacturer, trash can manufacturer and dumpster
  manufacturer that builds convenient, durable products with your needs in mind.
  
  [View Our Products][61]
[Toter top selling products]

## Top-Selling Products Are Built for Extremes®

Toter is the only disposal bin manufacturer that creates products that combine durability,
convenience and long-term value.
* Advanced Rotational Molding™ for seamless design
* Engineered for toughness and high-impact resistance
* Corrosion- and chemical-resistant
* Unique design and structural capabilities
* Custom colors and molded-in graphics available

[Toter Advantages][62]

## The Industry’s First 100% Recycled Cart Body

[Toter 100% recycled cart body]

The Toter EVR Green cart helps contribute to your sustainability initiatives through:
* 100% Recycled Cart Body
* Superior toughness and durability
* Industry leading 12 year body warranty
* Consistent wall thickness
* Corrosion and chemical resistant
   

[Learn More][63]
[Toter garbage can]

## Garbage In, Garbage Out

No one wants to deal with trash, but it must be contained and hauled away. Out of sight and out of
mind are our goals, and Toter meets these challenges with the most convenient and durable carts on
the market. Our products are guaranteed to meet or exceed the needs of the municipal,
retail/residential and pro/specialty markets.

[Toter products and services]

## Finding Treasure in Trash

Toter gets our customers the products and services they want, when they want them. We offer numerous
services, including project planning, data-driven cart management, assembly and delivery, and cart
maintenance to help you start or enhance a collection program. Our Customer Support Group is a real
treasure — and we’re here for you!

garantierten Schallleistungspegel gekennzeichnet.

### [ Herstellung und Zertifizierung von Mülltonnen & Abfallbehältern von Weber ][59]

Höchste Anforderungen an die zu verarbeitenden Rohstoffe gewährleisten eine maximale
Prozesssicherheit in der Fertigung unserer Abfall- und Wertstoffbehälter und sind Grundlage unserer
Qualitäts- und Umweltmanagementsysteme nach DIN ISO 9001 und DIN ISO 14001.

Darüber hinaus entsprechen unsere fahrbaren Zwei- und Vierrad-Mülltonnen und [Abfallcontainer][60]
sowohl den Kriterien der DIN EN 840 als auch der RAL GZ 951/1. Weiterhin sind die
[Müllcontainer][61] gemäß den Bestimmungen der Richtlinie 2000/14 EG mit dem CE-Zeichen sowie dem
garantierten Schallleistungspegel (LWA) gekennzeichnet.

Die [Müllbehälter][62] und Abfalleimer werden im Kompakt-Spritzgießverfahren aus hochmolekularem
Polyäthylen (HDPE) hergestellt. Dieses Material wurde speziell für die Herstellung von

Höchste Anforderungen an die zu verarbeitenden Rohstoffe gewährleisten eine maximale
Prozesssicherheit in der Fertigung unserer Abfall- und Wertstoffbehälter und sind Grundlage unserer
Qualitäts- und Umweltmanagementsysteme nach DIN ISO 9001 und DIN ISO 14001.

Darüber hinaus entsprechen unsere fahrbaren Zwei- und Vierrad-Mülltonnen und [Abfallcontainer][60]
sowohl den Kriterien der DIN EN 840 als auch der RAL GZ 951/1. Weiterhin sind die
[Müllcontainer][61] gemäß den Bestimmungen der Richtlinie 2000/14 EG mit dem CE-Zeichen sowie dem
garantierten Schallleistungspegel (LWA) gekennzeichnet.

Die [Müllbehälter][62] und Abfalleimer werden im Kompakt-Spritzgießverfahren aus hochmolekularem
Polyäthylen (HDPE) hergestellt. Dieses Material wurde speziell für die Herstellung von
[Abfalltonnen][63] bzw. Müllcontainern entwickelt und ist gemäß den international anerkannten
Qualitätsnormen zertifiziert. Auf Kundenwunsch wird geprüftes Recyclingmaterial aus gebrauchten
Abfallbehältern eingesetzt, welches die gleichen Spezifikationen erfüllen muss. Es ist
verrottungsfest, resistent gegen Kälte, Wärme, Chemikalien und durch eine spezielle
UV-Stabilisierung besonders alterungsbeständig.

Die Herstellung unserer Produkte geht mit einem hohen Energieeinsatz einher, der die Umwelt belastet
und durch die Endlichkeit fossiler Ressourcen zu stetig steigenden Energiekosten führt. Vor diesem
Hintergrund verpflichtet sich WEBER, den Energieverbrauch dauerhaft zu reduzieren, unnötige
Energieverbräuche zu vermeiden und unsere energiebezogene Leistung in einem kontinuierlichen
Verbesserungsprozess zu optimieren. Unser Unternehmen setzt dafür ein Energiemanagementsystem nach
DIN EN ISO 50001 ein. Der Schutz unserer Mitarbeiter, der Mitarbeiter unserer Subunternehmen und
Lieferanten ist ein zentrales Anliegen von WEBER. Wir setzen dafür ein Arbeitssicherheits- &
Gesundheitsschutzmanagementsystem nach ISO 45001 ein, welches in 2024 zertifiziert wurde.

## Regulated Waste Disposal Service You Can Count On

At Waste Medic, we don’t believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. We work closely with your team to
design a waste management plan tailored to your facility—and we’re ready to adjust when your needs

your healthcare facility, ensuring compliance, safety, and efficiency every step of the way.

your facility remains compliant with all laws while protecting your staff, patients, and the

## Prodotti

[separatore rosso corto]

Le due linee principali di prodotti offerte da APmedical sono i contenitori WASTE e i contenitori
SHARPS. Queste linee sono progettate appositamente per garantire una gestione sicura e efficiente
dei rifiuti ospedalieri, fornendo soluzioni affidabili per i professionisti della sanità.

## Azienda certificata ed eco-friendly

[separatore rosso corto]

I prodotti APmedical sono sottoposti a rigide certificazioni di qualità, garantendo il rispetto
delle normative internazionali più rigorose in termini di sicurezza. Realizzati con materiali
plastici di alta qualità, come il polipropilene copolimero colorato con pigmenti privi di cadmio o
altri materiali pesanti, i contenitori APmedical offrono resistenza ai fluidi e ai solventi.
Inoltre, consentono lo smaltimento attraverso l’incenerimento senza l’emissione di gas nocivi,
rispettando le normative internazionali sull’ambiente.

La linea Sharps Containers di APmedical, dedicata alla raccolta di aghi e rifiuti taglienti, è
progettata per resistere alla perforazione da parte degli aghi e delle cannule, che rappresenta la
principale fonte di infortuni per il personale ospedaliero. La linea Waste Containers, invece, offre
contenitori per rifiuti ospedalieri pericolosi. Questi contenitori sono dotati di un collante
perimetrale speciale che garantisce una sigillatura ermetica, prevenendo qualsiasi rischio di
infezione.

Gli contenitori APmedical sono estremamente robusti e solidi, in grado di resistere agli urti e alle
condizioni di trasporto più avverse verso discariche o impianti di incenerimento. Sono anche testati
per sopportare diverse temperature di utilizzo, garantendo la loro affidabilità in ogni situazione.

## Hazardous Waste Container for Hazardous Material Handling

[poly-drum-white-bg][poly-drum-white-bg]

When hazardous waste must be contained, transported, or consolidated, the packaging you choose
directly affects compliance, safety, and operational efficiency. A properly rated **hazardous waste

## More Services, More Options, More value

##### [[Regulatory Compliance]][21]

##### **Medical Waste Regulations and Compliance**

Regulated Medical Waste (RMW) also kown as “Infectious Waste”, “Bio-medical or Bio-Hazardous Waste”,
or “Red Bags” poses a risk of transmitting infection and diseases. It is required by federal,
state/provincial, and local laws that the medical waste be treated and rendered non-infectious
before it can be disposed of. Therefore, the operation of EcoMed Services further advances the goals
of managing the clinical waste in a manner which is most protective of human health and the
environment.  Our team is experienced in handling licensing and regulatory compliance.

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

# Progress with the
# Environment in Mind

## Since 1993, Leonel Waste Management Corporation (Leonel) has been providing effective,
## thorough, and continuous waste collection services to our clients.

**Scroll down to learn more**


# Services Offered

## Collection, Hauling, and
## Disposal of MSW

We currently serve several cities in Metro Manila. We cover everything from garbage collection to
solid waste segregation to proper transportation and disposal to sanitary landfills.

## Street Sweeping
## with Trucks

We offer fast and efficient curbside clean-ups by deploying street sweeper trucks.

## Events Waste Management
## (with Awareness Advertisments)

We can station garbage compactor trucks in events for quicker cleanups. If you would like to, you
can place your ads on our trucks to relay your company's environmental concern to the public.

# Fleet of Equipment

## Garbage Compactor Trucks

Garbage Compactor Trucks are the main vehicles used for garbage collection all around the world,
mainly because of its efficiency. A ten wheeler garbage compactor truck can accommodate as much as
1.5 times the capacity of a ten wheeler dump truck. Depending on the client's requirements, we have
various sized compactor trucks available to choose from.

## Ten Wheeler Dump Trucks

Dump trucks are more ideal to use for collection of very bulky solid waste. Call our office to ask
for the availability of long dump trucks, which are longer than the standard ten wheeler dump trucks
you see on the streets.

## Industrial Roll-off Garbage Dumpsters

Roll-off garbage dumpsters are left in an area where they act as receptacles for garbage for a
certain period of time. It serves as the entire vicinity's giant garbage bin. It is then collected
during its scheduled pick-up time, emptied, and then returned to the client. A single industrial
roll-off garbage dumpster can accommodate two to three mid to high rise residential condominiums
daily.

## Street Sweeper Trucks

Street Sweeper Trucks are ideal for curb side cleaning. A single street sweeper truck can do the job
of several people in sweeping the curbs in a fraction of the time, generating you savings in the
process.

## Water Tanker with High Pressure Washer"

This water tanker with a high pressure washer can provide solutions for cleansing of concrete floors
that that need to be rid of stubborn dirt and odors which can no longer be dealt with using a broom
and a dustpan.

# Photo Gallery

# Mission-Vision

**Our mission** is to satisfy our stakeholders by providing our customers value, our fellow citizens
peace of mind, our employees fair compensation, and our investors an equitable return. **Our
vision** is to be the foremost integrated waste solutions company in the country by setting the
benchmark in quality and reliability in garbage collection and disposal.

# About Us

**Leonel Waste Management Corporation (Leonel) was registered in 1993 with the objective of
providing effective, thorough, and continuous waste collection services to our clients.**

Our fleet of equipment composed of garbage compactors, dump trucks, roll-on roll-of trucks, sweeper
trucks, water trucks, and heavy equipment, as well as our workforce, is more than enough to
adequately meet any new assignment. Leonel has been aggressively looking for opportunities to join
the renewable energy industry - in line with our commitment to contribute to the environment.

Leonel's long-term objective is not only to contribute to cleanliness and beautification, but also
to advance efforts in addressing the issues of solid waste by turning this into an opportunity
through innovation and collaborations with the renewable energy sector.

## Reusable Sharps and Pharm Management

Safe, Compliant, and Reliable Disposal of Medical Waste for Healthcare and Beyond.

MediWaste Offers a sustainable compliance solution for large quantity generators looking for
Reduction in environmental impact while maintaining the highest quality standards for safety and
regulatory compliance We provide the Rehrig family of reusable sharps and pharm containers and
custom build a service that can include self service or a full service Options For your healthcare
facilities.

[ Learn More ][131]

## Hazardous Waste

Expert Handling and Disposal of Hazardous Waste with Safety and Compliance at the Core

Handling hazardous waste requires expertise and precision, and MediWaste is equipped to manage even
the most challenging waste streams. Our hazardous waste services include chemical disposal, lab
packing, site mitigation, and soil remediation, all conducted by our HAZWOPER-certified technicians.
We ensure that all hazardous materials are disposed of safely and in full compliance with regulatory
standards, protecting both your business and the environment.

[ Learn More ][132]

## Document Destruction

Secure, Confidential, and Compliant Document Destruction You Can Trust.

Protecting sensitive information is critical, and MediWaste offers secure document shredding
services to help you stay compliant with HIPAA and other confidentiality standards. Whether you need
on-site or off site shredding, our NAID-certified services ensure that your documents are securely
disposed of, safeguarding your data and maintaining your reputation. From transportation to
destruction, we handle the entire process with the highest level of security and professionalism.

## Why Professional Waste Disposal?

Professional medical waste management is the most effective way to ensure that your comunity remains
safe, you are complying with regulations, and your organization remains trusted. When medical waste
is simply thrown in the trash, individuals who come into contact with it can be harmed.
Additionally, improperly handled materials can end up in public spaces, pollute waterways, and leach
into the soil. Regulations on the local, state, and federal levels set important standards that
businesses, clinics, hospitals, and homes must follow. When an organization breaks these rules
designed to keep people safe, trust is broken. Medical Waste Pros can find you unique solutions for
your exact needs. 

## Looking for something local?

Medical Waste Pros proudly offers a network of convenient drop-off locations for sharps and
pharmaceuticals nationwide. Easily locate a nearby facility to safely dispose of your small
quantities of sharps and medications.

## Waste Solutions For Brighter Tomorrow

MSGP Infra Tech Pvt. Ltd. is a pioneer in integrated solid waste management in Bengaluru. As the
first company in India to establish a Waste Tech Park, MSGP leads the way in waste reuse, recycling,
and energy recovery. Processing over 750 tons of waste per day, MSGP transforms municipal solid
waste into compost, fuel, and usable materials—creating value from what others discard.

#### Vision

To be a leading, integrated solid waste management company that empowers people and organizations to
build sustainable ecosystems across the planet.

#### Mission

To achieve integrated waste management through the 3Rs — Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle — fostering a
cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable environment.

Our Work

## A unified center for all your waste management needs.

#### Commercial Waste Management:

End-to-end waste management for businesses—collection, segregation, and recycling. Responsible
handling of recyclable and organic waste. Helps your business meet sustainability and compliance
goals.

#### Residential Waste Management

MSGP partners with communities to promote waste segregation at source. From doorstep collection to
composting and recycling, we help create cleaner neighborhoods and greener cities.

#### Smart Waste Management:

We combine technology with sustainable practices to turn waste into resources. At our Material
Recovery Facility, advanced systems process organic waste into compost and recyclables into reusable
materials.

Vermi Compost

ELF Fertiliser
Liquid formulation derived from organic compost.
Refuse Derived Fuel (RDF)
Sustainable energy source made from non-recyclable waste.

* ## There’s a Toter® to Meet Everyone’s Needs
  
  Your needs are simple — collecting and transporting waste from its source to the next point in the
  waste stream. Toter is the waste container manufacturer, trash can manufacturer and dumpster
  manufacturer that builds convenient, durable products with your needs in mind.
  
  [View Our Products][61]
[Toter top selling products]

## Top-Selling Products Are Built for Extremes®

Toter is the only disposal bin manufacturer that creates products that combine durability,
convenience and long-term value.
* Advanced Rotational Molding™ for seamless design
* Engineered for toughness and high-impact resistance
* Corrosion- and chemical-resistant
* Unique design and structural capabilities
* Custom colors and molded-in graphics available

[Toter Advantages][62]

## The Industry’s First 100% Recycled Cart Body

[Toter 100% recycled cart body]

The Toter EVR Green cart helps contribute to your sustainability initiatives through:
* 100% Recycled Cart Body
* Superior toughness and durability
* Industry leading 12 year body warranty
* Consistent wall thickness
* Corrosion and chemical resistant
   

[Learn More][63]
[Toter garbage can]

## Garbage In, Garbage Out

No one wants to deal with trash, but it must be contained and hauled away. Out of sight and out of
mind are our goals, and Toter meets these challenges with the most convenient and durable carts on
the market. Our products are guaranteed to meet or exceed the needs of the municipal,
retail/residential and pro/specialty markets.

[Toter products and services]

## Finding Treasure in Trash

Toter gets our customers the products and services they want, when they want them. We offer numerous
services, including project planning, data-driven cart management, assembly and delivery, and cart
maintenance to help you start or enhance a collection program. Our Customer Support Group is a real
treasure — and we’re here for you!

  and without locking you into long-term contracts—so your team can stay focused on what matters

## Regulated Waste Disposal Service You Can Count On

At Waste Medic, we don’t believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. We work closely with your team to
design a waste management plan tailored to your facility—and we’re ready to adjust when your needs
change. Whether it’s an unscheduled pickup or a shift in volume, you can count on timely, reliable
service from a team that knows your operation.

Proudly serving the Southeastern United States, we build real relationships with every client.
You’ll know your driver by name, and we’ll know your workflow—delivering consistent, attentive
service that keeps your team safe and compliant.

## Specialized Medical Waste Services

Our comprehensive range of medical waste disposal services is designed to meet the specific needs of
your healthcare facility, ensuring compliance, safety, and efficiency every step of the way.

### [ Biohazardous Waste ][28]

Healthcare regulations around biohazardous waste are strict—and for good reason. Waste Medic ensures
your facility remains compliant with all laws while protecting your staff, patients, and the
environment. With us, there are no hidden costs—just dependable service when you need it.

### [ Medical Sharps Waste ][29]

Safety and simplicity are essential for sharps waste. At Waste Medic, we offer safe, responsible,
and cost-effective disposal solutions tailored to your facility’s specific needs. Our reliable
service allows you to focus on delivering exceptional care to your patients.

### [ Pharmaceutical Waste ][30]

Handling pharmaceutical waste can feel overwhelming, but Waste Medic makes it manageable. We
collaborate with your team to ensure proper segregation and compliant disposal, giving you peace of
mind that your facility is operating efficiently and safely.

### [ Trace Chemotherapy Waste ][31]

As one of the most hazardous types of medical waste, trace chemotherapy waste requires specialized
disposal. Waste Medic provides tailored transportation and disposal solutions that guarantee
compliance and protect the safety of your facility.
